tips.text: Run Conservation (Kubrodon, Bolarola, Stover) for the fastest Solaris standing to Doer.
Buy the cheap Training and Shelter Debt-Bonds from Ticker and check his rotating cases early.
Run the Profit-Taker for Medical Debt-Bonds; it always drops them.
Kill the Exploiter Orb in one squad run for trade-in gems worth about a day's standing.
Stockpile Father Tokens ahead of the gild; you can earn them past the daily standing cap.
Skip Forma until after gilding; the gild supplies a free polarity.
